thread:
Zoe: hi everyone, Zoe from product! First week and stuck on cloud onboarding. Trying to create a dev project in asia-northeast1 for latency testing but gcloud fails with org policy. Also I can't see any billing accounts in the console. I need a KMS key for encrypting test datasets and access to pubsub. Who do I ping to get a sandbox + kms + billing link?

Miguel-Cloud: welcome Zoe :wave: We spin up onboarding projects under ENG-Onboarding. Looks like the org blocks self-serve project creation. I can create the sandbox if finance links ENG-Playground billing. Can you confirm your GitHub id and desired project-id? Also do you need shared VPC or private Google access?

Zoe: github id is zoe-park. prefer `zoe-apac-sbox`. Need pubsub, compute, secretmanager, and a KMS key in asia-northeast1. No shared VPC, but need egress to us-west1 for a test service.

Miguel-Cloud: got it. I'll open INF ticket to provision the project and KMS key. FYI VPC Service Controls are enabled for some prod folders; since this is onboarding under ENG-Onboarding we shouldn't hit VPC-SC, but mention if you need restricted ingress.

ops-bot: Created billing request CL-7770 for ENG-Playground. Requester: Zoe. Status: pending finance approval.

Priya-SRE: Adding you to `redwood-engineers` Okta group enables AWS assume-role. For GCP, once the project exists we can create a workload-identity binding for any GKE tests. If you need a KMS key policy allowing external test accounts, mention that now.

Zoe: thanks! Please set KMS key to allow `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for the service account `zoe-test-sa`. Also can you enable CMEK on storage buckets?

Miguel-Cloud: noted. INF-12045 created to make `zoe-apac-sbox`, create `zoe-test-sa@zoe-apac-sbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, create KMS key `projects/zeo/locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/zoe-kr/cryptoKeys/zoe-key`, enable APIs: cloudkms.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, compute.googleapis.com, storage.googleapis.com. ETA ~3h after billing link.

ops-bot: INF-12045 assigned to Miguel-Cloud. Link: https://tickets.internal/INF-12045

Priya-SRE: Once billing is linked and project exists, run: `gcloud kms keys encrypt --key=projects/PROJECT/locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/KEYRING/cryptoKeys/KEY --plaintext-file=secrets.txt --ciphertext-file=secrets.enc` to verify CMEK works. For AWS assume-role test (if you need it), run `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer --role-session-name zoe-test` after Okta group addition.

Zoe: perfect. One more Q: how do I check if org policy will prevent enabling certain APIs in that region? I saw a `constraints/gcp.resourceLocations` enforcement earlier.

Miguel-Cloud: good catch. I'll check org policy for ENG-Onboarding folder; if asia-northeast1 is blocked we can put the sandbox in asia-east1 or us-west1 with lower latency to your infra. I'll confirm in the ticket.

ops-bot: CL-7770 approved by Finance. Billing linked to ENG-Playground.

Miguel-Cloud: billing linked. Proceeding to provision project and KMS key now. I9ll update INF-12045 with final region choice if policy requires change.

Zoe: thanks all, appreciate the help :tada:
